knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The guideline specifies a filter capable of trapping very fine particles, which keeps dust from being blown back into the room. The other options miss that requirement.
A detergent mix followed by ventilation is the method the guideline sets. Hypochlorite and alcohol are not used on soft furnishings or spills.
The guideline's trigger is visible dust or soiling. The other options do not match the stated trigger.

practicalCriteria: Learner vacuums a carpet area and states the filter type in use.
Learner cleans a simulated soft furnishing spill with detergent and identifies the drying step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Carpet and soft furnishing clean record
stopWorkCriteria: A spill on carpet or upholstery includes body substance and the learner has no protective equipment
The equipment filter is damaged or missing
